We mock a boy whose grandest dream is just jam on his toast, forgetting that in a world built on terror, simple warmth is the ultimate rebellion. We gladly trade our freedom to escape our grief, but true humanity isn't surviving the dark—it's daring to keep a soft heart while holding the blade.
